tagline: Procedural textures, live. The file holds the recipe.
description:
Upstream texgen.js is a library. This is an editor: stack XOR, sines, noise, checkers, twirls; combine with add, multiply, xor; tint each layer; download a PNG. It runs fully offline. There is no account, and nothing is sent anywhere.

The stack is the save. Name a recipe, keep it, close the app — it is still there. Share the GIF and the recipe travels with it. Presets from the original examples are one tap, including the classic XOR look.

Unofficial port of texgen.js by mrdoob. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
